properties.title: Aisin Corp. Secures Government Subsidy for India Production Project
properties.summary: Aisin Corp. has seen a 2.4% increase in its stock price, closing at 2,575 yen, following the acceptance of its application for a government subsidy aimed at supporting its overseas production verification project in India. This initiative focuses on the production of continuously variable transmissions (CVT), marking a significant step in the company's international expansion efforts.

properties.title: Aisin Corp Faces Scrutiny Over AS69RC Transmission Issues in RAM HD Trucks
properties.summary: Aisin Corp faces increasing scrutiny over its AS69RC transmission used in RAM HD trucks, with reports of severe issues including jerky shifting and overheating. Recent findings have identified manufacturing flaws in the K1 input shaft drum sub-assembly and K1 clutch snap ring in the 2022 and 2023 models, prompting discussions among truck owners about the need for improved maintenance practices and the possibility of extended warranties for affected vehicles.

properties.title: New Technical Bulletins Address Aisin Transmission Failures in Ram HD Trucks
properties.summary: Aisin's AS69RC transmission issues in Ram HD trucks have prompted new technical service bulletins from Ram addressing the K1 Clutch Snap Ring failure. The NHTSA is now investigating these transmission failures, which have been linked to manufacturing defects in key components. This development has reignited discussions among truck owners regarding the reliability of Aisin transmissions in their vehicles.

properties.title: Aisin Corp Faces 90% Profit Drop Amidst Market Challenges and Shifts Towards Electric Vehicles
properties.summary: Aisin Corp faces a dramatic 90% drop in net profit to 8 billion yen, driven by fierce price competition in China and production halts among domestic manufacturers. The company has revised its profit forecasts downward, reflecting a broader downturn affecting five companies within the Toyota Group. In response, Aisin is accelerating structural reforms and reducing fixed costs while emphasizing the urgent need to pivot towards electric vehicles to remain competitive in the evolving automotive market.

properties.title: Aisin Corp Navigates Tariff Challenges Amidst Strong Hybrid Vehicle Demand
properties.summary: Aisin Corp is facing a complex situation as it benefits from strong demand for hybrid vehicles in the U.S. market, even as it grapples with the potential negative impacts of the Trump administration's tariff policies. While overall sales have slightly declined, the company remains optimistic about its hybrid vehicle segment, which is crucial for its financial performance amidst these challenges.

properties.title: Aisin Manufacturing Class Action Lawsuit Advances with New Court Order
properties.summary: Aisin Manufacturing faces a class action lawsuit led by Jonathon Steinsultz, alleging harmful manufacturing practices in Illinois. A recent court order dated March 3, 2025, has established a timeline for objections regarding disclosures in the case, underscoring the gravity of the allegations against the company and the potential impact on the quality and safety of their automotive parts.

properties.title: Class Action Lawsuit Against Aisin Manufacturing Moves Forward with Key Deadlines
properties.summary: A class action lawsuit against Aisin Manufacturing Illinois has progressed with a scheduling order issued by Judge Staci Yandle. The order sets significant pretrial and trial deadlines for December 3, 2026, outlining key dates for motions and disclosures related to the case.

properties.title: Aisin Corp Faces 90% Profit Drop, Implements Structural Reforms Amid Market Challenges
properties.summary: Aisin Corp has reported a dramatic 90% decline in net profit to 8 billion yen, driven by fierce price competition in the Chinese market and production halts among domestic manufacturers. This downturn has prompted the company to revise its profit forecasts downward, reflecting a troubling trend among five companies within the Toyota Group. In response, Aisin is implementing structural reforms and cost-cutting measures to address the challenges in the automotive market, which may have significant implications for investor confidence and market dynamics.

properties.title: Aisin Corp Lowers Profit Forecasts Amidst Optimistic Consensus
properties.summary: Aisin Corp has made significant downward revisions to its operating profit forecasts for the fiscal year ending March 2026, now projecting a 2.5% decrease to 242.65 billion yen. This adjustment reflects a shift from a previously anticipated 43.4% increase to a 39.9% increase compared to last year's figures. Despite these changes, the consensus remains more optimistic than the company's own forecast of 215 billion yen, indicating a complex outlook for the company moving forward.

properties.title: Aisin Corp's Workplace Mental Health Crisis: Court Links Employee Suicide to Job Stress
properties.summary: Aisin Corp faces heightened scrutiny following a Nagoya District Court ruling that a former employee's suicide was work-related due to excessive job demands. This landmark decision emphasizes the connection between workplace stress and mental health, challenging previous findings and raising questions about corporate accountability in Japan.

properties.title: Court Rules Employee's Suicide Work-Related, Grants Survivor Benefits
properties.summary: The Nagoya District Court has ruled that the suicide of a male employee at Aisin High Hall was work-related, leading to a significant overturn of a previous decision regarding survivor benefits. The court highlighted that the employee's team had underreported working hours, revealing a troubling increase in overtime that contributed to his depression and tragic death.

properties.title: Aisin Corp to Close Gamagori Factory by 2027, Sparking Job Loss Concerns
properties.summary: Aisin Corp has announced plans to close its Gamagori factory by March 2027 as part of a restructuring strategy to shift automatic transmission parts manufacturing to other locations. This decision has sparked concerns among workers and local residents about potential job losses and the economic impact on the community, which has relied on the factory since its opening in 2004.

properties.title: Aisin Corp to Close Gamagori Plant by 2027
properties.summary: Aisin Corp has revealed plans to close its Gamagori Plant by March 2027 as part of a major restructuring effort. This facility, which has been operational since 2004 and employs around 250 workers, specializes in manufacturing components for automatic transmissions.

properties.title: Aisin Corp Under Scrutiny for Disaster Preparedness Following Noto Peninsula Earthquake Damage
properties.summary: Aisin Corp faces scrutiny after its Tazuhama factory sustained significant damage from the recent Noto Peninsula earthquake, raising alarms about the company's disaster preparedness. The incident has prompted a broader examination of disaster response strategies among 16 companies in the region, highlighting the urgent need for enhanced resilience in Central Japan's manufacturing sector.

properties.title: Aisin Corp Featured in Resilience Case Study Post-Noto Peninsula Earthquake
properties.summary: Aisin Corp and 15 other manufacturers have been highlighted in a new case study collection by the Chubu Bureau of Economy, Trade and Industry, following the disruptions caused by the 2024 Noto Peninsula earthquake.
